name: R-15: the Syft installer scan of a distributed build has no UNREVIEWED finding and every disallowed license has a recorded disposition
command: VM osr18b (guest script .papercusp/scratch/osr/r18/guest-build9.sh): git fetch; git reset --hard origin/HEAD of Papercusp/papercusp-app -> PUBLIC_HEAD=3c1ed9a1d7ddf2823f4892e94516c9f8b519d80c; git status --porcelain EMPTY (STATUS_BEFORE_STANDIN)
disclosed stand-in only: tauri.conf.json plugins.updater.pubkey := tester minisign pubkey; npm ci; operator-vite build; papercusp-desktop npm ci (STATUS_AFTER_INSTALL: only tauri.conf.json)
.papercusp/scratch/osr/r0026/scan.sh: same scanner, same flags, over the 3 signed 0.0.26-alpha Linux installers from the release cut (log .papercusp/scratch/osr/r0026/scan.log)
summary: Built from the public repo head 3c1ed9a1d7dd with ZERO source patches (git status empty after reset and after npm ci; the only modified tracked file before the build is the disclosed updater pubkey stand-in in tauri.conf.json, which a third-party builder must supply and which does not change bundled content or licenses). All three finished Linux installers pass the installer license leg with 0 UNREVIEWED and 0 denied: GUI deb (sha256 88c6c36b…) 2,078 files, 4/4 payloads covered; Server deb (8427b0d0…) 14,198 files, 648 Syft packages, 818 covered; AppImage (5a6e7e19…) 2,500 files, 338 payloads, 341 covered. The only non-permissive license outside the LGPL/MPL runtime is GNU readline linked into the bundled psql tools, shipped as the recorded aggregate component in scripts/installer-components.json (PostgreSQL AND GPL-3.0-or-later, with the offer-source obligation). No GPL-only AppImage library remains (D-013). Build-machine prerequisites, not source changes: embedding models fetched via bin/lib/transformers-models.sh into ~/r18/models, and syft in ~/.local/bin. The in-build scan pass ran without syft on PATH and reported LICENSE_GATE_RESULT status=undetermined for all three (not pass); the evidence here is the re-scan of the SAME bytes (identical sha256) with syft present. The build also rewrote package-lock.json to mark ~20 workspace entries absent from the export as extraneous (filed WI-10004261); that affects lockfile hygiene, not installer content. Scope: this certifies installers built from the public source; the 0.0.25 AppImage currently on the download channel predates D-013 and is superseded by the next published release (0.0.26), whose signed Linux installers already pass the same scan (assert next-distributed-candidate-0026-clean) but are not yet uploaded.
